cases.raw: I need to fix the signup error that only appears after an invite is accepted, and test the pricing experiment comparing usage-based billing with seats. The build is getting slow after the new analytics package, so I should profile the render path before we add another dashboard. I also need to document onboarding so a new developer can run the app without asking me where the environment variables come from. While I am in there, I keep thinking about a later product idea: a tiny release assistant that turns a pull request into a clear customer update.
